source.title: Run a giveaway that grows your reach

document.title: Run a giveaway that grows your reach

use_when: A giveaway requires a tagged comment, a follow and an email before the entry is treated as valid.
avoid_when: Do not use when email is optional or the goal is to distribute a free resource immediately.
Do not silently drop an essential unsupported gate.
required_facts: Entry rules, eligible post, giveaway identity, email purpose and winner/fulfillment process.
Confirm account scope, messaging permission and the real outcome measurement.
